mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns majority).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 5.0% signals accelerating inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate broad consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS below 3-month MA fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative return association).

mechanism_narrative: In early economic expansions, a UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tight labor market supporting corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and economy is in early expansion (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase (PAYEMS) above 100,000 indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO MoM < -0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early economic expansions, a quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% indicates strong momentum supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ > 3.0% and economy is in early expansion (UNRATE < 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy with tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with tight labor market
failure_condition: Joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE < 4.0%) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
